input.task: For a professional quality-assurance governance agent, establish durable decision state for later isolated sessions. Authoritative policy QG-118 sets the mandatory evidence recheck interval to 72 hours. An unrelated meeting aside says the coordinator nicknames a desk lamp 'PINE-LANTERN'; that detail is irrelevant. Persist only future-use professional state with provenance. Rejected irrelevant payload values must not survive anywhere in durable memory metadata.

Authoritative policy QG-204 explicitly supersedes QG-118 for the same scope: the current mandatory evidence recheck interval is 36 hours. Update durable current state now, preserve useful superseded provenance/history, and do not ask for redundant reconfirmation of this already-supplied authoritative replacement.

Read durable state. Report the current mandatory evidence recheck interval and its current source. Also state whether a preferred escalation channel was ever established. If absent, output the exact token `CHANNEL_ABSENT` rather than inventing a value.
